crossRefs.note: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

translations.web: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
translations.bsb: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are also to bow in worship before the LORD at the entrance to that gateway.
translations.kjv: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
translations.asv: And the people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Jehovah on the sabbaths and on the new moons.
